alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 20 at 3:21PM PST until November 21 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...The San Joaquin Valley.

* WHEN...From midnight tonight to 10 AM PST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highways affected include interstate 5,
highways 99, 43, 41, 198, 152, 46, and 58.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
